segments.title: September
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! September is The Comeback, plus fifty-seven days to Diwali. Routines are back, festive photos are coming, and everyone suddenly remembers they wanted to feel great in October. We're here to help, with a deadline.

segments.title: ₹39.6L
segments.text: So, the number. Our September target for Kemps Corner is 39.6 lakh rupees. That's 24 per cent more than last September. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 21.8 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 9.5 lakh, comebacks 4.75 lakh, and everything else 3.56 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 85 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 620 leads, 316 trials, and 85 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 23.6 lakh rupees, which is 59 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Glow-Up or Give Back
segments.text: First up, for newcomers, Glow-Up or Give Back. We measure on day one and again before the festive photos. Do thirty classes and don't improve? The third month is on us. Confidence, guaranteed. The plan is 12 buyers at about 34,400, so 4.13 lakh rupees.

segments.title: New Phone, Who Dis?
segments.text: Next, for everyone else who drifted, New Phone, Who Dis? One free, no-questions-asked comeback class. Buy within seven days, and get fifteen per cent off plus an extra freeze. The plan is 24 buyers at about 17,200, so 4.13 lakh rupees.

segments.title: We Need to Talk
segments.text: Then, We Need to Talk. Not like that. Our studio managers personally call high-value lapsed members. Say yes, and get six months at twenty per cent off, unlimited freezes and a private to restart. The plan is 5 buyers at about 70,000, so 3.5 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Lock It Before the Laddoos
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Lock It Before the Laddoos. Renew for three months by the thirtieth: fifteen per cent off, a Diwali hamper, and unlimited freezes for festive travel. The plan is 24 buyers at about 49,200, so 11.8 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, newcomers measure day one and hear the glow-up guarantee. Week two, studio managers call our highest-value lapsed members. Week three, the seven-day comeback window opens for everyone else. Week four, every renewal is locked before the laddoos arrive.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's September at Kemps Corner. 39.6 lakh rupees, four offers, and 85 buyers to welcome. Fifty-seven days. No pressure. Well, a little pressure.
